items.title: WattsOrbit ships publicly Friday June 19, 2026
items.body:
WattsOrbit goes public on **Friday June 19** — slipped from Monday so the new battery-health surface and 80% charge-limit alerts could finish QA on real hardware. Same drop day as CloudOrbit.

- Real-time watts in / watts out
- Per-USB-device wattage breakdown
- Battery cycles, temperature, and capacity
- Smart notifications (weak charger, low battery, 80% charge limit)

Free and open source. MIT.

items.title: CloudOrbit launches Friday June 19, 2026
items.body:
The first stable build of CloudOrbit now drops on **Friday June 19** — we slipped from Monday so the SSO + kubeconfig path could get one more pass against real corporate proxies. Same launch day as WattsOrbit.

- AWS SSO session manager, no terminal needed
- Auto-updates kubeconfig as you switch profiles
- Detects EKS clusters from your active session
- Works behind Cloudflare and corporate proxies

Free, native Rust binary. Sign up to get notified the moment it ships.

items.title: DataOrbit launches Monday June 29, 2026
items.body:
The native DynamoDB GUI for macOS now ships **Monday June 29** — pushed back one more week to give the cross-table join engine and live-stream UI a longer soak with real customer datasets.

- Live DynamoDB Streams
- Cross-table joins (inner / left / left-anti / right / right-anti)
- Full query history
- No Electron, no JVM warm-up — pure Rust + Tauri

Free forever. MIT licensed.

items.title: BastionOrbit — public launch later in 2026
items.body:
BastionOrbit has been moved off its July 3 slot. The auto-expiry TTL flow and multi-bastion connectivity probe need more soak time before going public.

- One-click port forwarding through bastion hosts
- Auto-expiry TTL — never leave a tunnel open overnight
- Multi-bastion management with connectivity probing
- Pairs with DataOrbit for tunneled DB connections

Real `ssh -N -L` processes — no protocol reimplementation. Free forever. Sign up for the launch date drop.

items.title: klight — public launch later in 2026
items.body:
klight has been moved off the May 29 slot. The three-world rollout (Solo dev, Startup team, Remote cluster) needs more soak time before going public — we'd rather ship it right than ship it on a deadline.

- Full-stack Kubernetes envs in two commands
- Postgres, Kafka, Redis spin up in the right order
- Each developer gets their own namespace
- Local minikube, team sync, or remote EKS / GKE / AKS — same CLI

Open source under MIT. Sign up to get notified the moment a launch date is locked.

items.title: ProxyOrbit — public launch later in 2026
items.body:
ProxyOrbit doesn't have a public launch date yet — the MITM cert chain and Zscaler workaround flow need another QA pass before going public.

- Capture HTTP/HTTPS from any Mac app
- Filter by method, status, host, path
- Real-time request log with body inspection
- Native Rust + Hyper + Tokio — under 30 MB at idle

No subscription, no $50 license. MIT. Sign up to get notified the moment a date is locked.

items.title: Speed up DynamoDB queries with GSIs
items.body:
Scanning large DynamoDB tables is slow and expensive. Use **Global Secondary Indexes** to turn full-table scans into targeted key lookups.

In DataOrbit's query builder, open the **Index** dropdown to pick a GSI — the filter fields automatically update to match the index's partition and sort key.

Always prefer a GSI query over a Scan when you know the access pattern.

items.title: Keep the tray popup open
items.body: By default the tray popup hides when it loses focus. Hold ⌥ (Option) while clicking the menu-bar icon and the popup stays pinned — useful when you want to watch wattage drift while you do something else.
